paragraphs.text: Think of this as your official checkbook register—everything here has already been posted to your books. When you need to record something by hand, use Add; when something looks wrong, open the row menu to edit or remove it.

If you find yourself entering the same kind of entry over and over (rent, paycheck split, transfer between accounts), save the line pattern as a replayable template so you can drop it in next time instead of retyping.
